title: Nash Bash Retreat | Neon Sign + Sleeps 13
description:
⭐️ Welcome to Flower Corner! ⭐️
📍Nashville, TN

Just minutes from downtown Nashville, our stylish condo is the ideal home base for groups looking to explore the city in comfort and style. Step into a bright, spacious interior with chic, IG-worthy decor—perfect for capturing memories with your crew. The fully stocked kitchen is ready for everything from morning coffee to evening cocktails and group dinners.

The space
Enhance your Nashville getaway with exclusive savings on top attractions and experiences. Through our partnership with Tripster, Halara Hosting guests enjoy special discounts on shows, tours, museums, and local favorites—available through our private booking link after reservation.

To access the discounted offers, simply search “Halara Hosting Nashville Tripster” in your browser or message us during your stay and we’ll be happy to share the booking link with you!

We stock the home with starter supplies to get you comfortably through your first day or two — toilet paper, hand soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, dish soap, dishwasher and laundry pods, paper towels, and trash bags. For longer stays or larger groups, you may want to grab a few extras. Kroger is about 3–4 minutes away. If you run short or can't find something, just message us — we're always happy to help!

⭐️⭐️ LOCATION ⭐️⭐️
 📍Kroger: 0.8 miles / 3–4 minutes
📍 Broadway (Downtown Nashville): 2.5 miles / 10-minute drive
📍 Nissan Stadium: 1.5 miles / 5-minute drive
📍 Ryman Auditorium: 2.5 miles / 10-minute drive
📍 Bridgestone Arena: 2.5 miles / 10-minute drive
📍 Country Music Hall of Fame: 2.7 miles / 10-minute drive
📍 Johnny Cash Museum: 2.5 miles / 10-minute drive
📍 Frist Art Museum: 3 miles / 12-minute drive
📍 Shelby Park: 1 mile / 5-minute drive
📍 Five Points (East Nashville dining & shops): 0.5 miles / 2-minute drive or 10-minute walk
📍 Opryland & Grand Ole Opry: 10 miles / 20-minute drive
📍 Nashville International Airport (BNA): 8 miles / 15-minute drive

⭐️⭐️ KEY FEATURES ⭐️⭐️
✔ Fully Equipped Kitchen
✔ High Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Trendy Decor
✔ Living Room TV
✔ Selfie-Light
✔ Two Car Parking
✔ Community Washer & Dryer 

⭐️⭐️ SUPPLIES PROVIDED DURING YOUR STAY⭐️⭐️
✔ Linens & Towels
✔ Shampoo, Conditioner & Body Wash
✔ Hand Soap
✔ Make Up Wipes
✔ Toilet Paper, Paper Towels & Trash Bags
✔ Laundry Pods
✔ Dishwasher Pods

❤️ Hosts Who Care ❤️

⭐️⭐️ HOME LAYOUT ⭐️⭐️
Accommodates 13 Guests

🏠 Located on the 1st Floor
- Bedroom 1:  King Bed 
- Bedroom 2:  King Bed 
- Bedroom 3: 1 Full Bed and 3x Twin Beds  
- Bedroom 4: 1 Full Bed and 3x Twin Beds 
- 2 Full Bathrooms

Guest access
We've set up a convenient electronic keypad on the front door, so there's no need to worry about carrying keys or coordinating check-ins.

Other things to note
GENERAL RULES
- There is a $250 Pet Fee for up to (2) pets (cats or dogs under 70 lbs)
- Only the guests listed on your reservation are permitted
- Large gatherings or events exceeding occupancy must be pre-approved and may incur additional fees
- Please do not use more than 6 bags of trash

SUPPLIES & ESSENTIALS
- We stock the home with starter supplies to get you comfortably through your first day or two — toilet paper, hand soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, dish soap, dishwasher and laundry pods, paper towels, and trash bags. For longer stays or larger groups, you may want to grab a few extras. If you run short or can't find something, just message us — we're always happy to help

MID-STAY CLEANING
- We offer mid-stay cleaning for an additional fee upon request and subject to availability

TRASH PICKUP & FEES
- Guests are allowed 6 bags of trash per stay for free. It’s no problem if you have extra bags! However, please note there may be a $50 excess trash fee 

Thank you for your understanding and adhere to it:
Guests are allowed up to 6 bags of trash per stay without a fee. Anything beyond that will result in a $50 trash fee.

BOOKING DETAILS
- Changes to reservations are not accepted after 24 hours of booking
- Guests must be 21+ years old to book
- Unfortunately, no refunds will be issued for circumstances beyond our control, including inclement weather, health-related issues, or other unforeseen/extenuating circumstances. We highly suggest purchasing travel insurance.
